summary: Smoke tested freshly imported school exam platform from GitHub. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed (auth, app-settings, academic-years, quizzes, profile, question-bank, gradebooks, rubrics, lesson-plans). Frontend: Home page renders (Arabic RTL, dark theme, exam code entry + teacher login link). Teacher login with admin/teacher123 succeeds and lands on /teacher/dashboard. Navigation to Dashboard, Question Bank, Gradebooks, Rubrics all render without errors. Native <select> dropdowns in Question Bank contain real Arabic option text (lessons, question types, cognitive levels, difficulty) - visual-edits injection bug is NOT present (DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS=true is working). No console errors detected.

minor.issue: GET /api/ returns 404 (no root health route). Not user-facing; /api/auth/login and everything else works. Consider adding a lightweight health route for infra checks.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is ~2600 lines - should be split into routers/modules per resource (auth, quizzes, question-bank, gradebooks, rubrics, lesson-plans) for maintainability.
No GET /api/ health endpoint; only sub-resource routes. Add a trivial /api/ or /api/health for uptime probes.
seed_data_creation: None - used pre-seeded admin account and existing question-bank data (lessons visible in dropdown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh import from https://github.com/alhabsi7772-coder/school.git is running healthy end-to-end. Backend routes use /api prefix via APIRouter. Auth: POST /api/auth/login returns JWT token, role 'admin'. Teacher pages under /teacher/*. Note lesson plans route is /teacher/library/plans (not /teacher/lesson-plans). Visual-edits plugin disabled via DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS=true in frontend/.env - keep this to avoid <select> injection bug. Existing test files in /app/backend/tests/ (test_gradebook_flow, test_lesson_plans, test_question_bank, etc.) available for deeper regression.
